correctness.rationale: Proved the symbolic arch/run automaton recurrence A_j=1+zuE+zA_(j+1) when j<h and E=1+zA_1+zA_2 (where A_2=0 for h=1). Solving gives exact all-h rational GF; positive coefficient factors prove exact support and extremizers. For fixed h>=2 the dominant simple pole is unique because lengths 2 and 3 both occur; logarithmic derivatives yield rigorous CLT coefficients. Independently tested 249399 enumerated hosts, 2777 literal host checks and a separate labeled transfer recurrence.

originality.rationale: The unrestricted binary universality law and generic regular-language counting algorithms are known. Neither inspected primary counting section gives the simultaneous all-cap rational formula, gap-free sharp support, exact longest witnesses or cap-specific Gaussian constants. Targeted published-record and owned-history comparisons identified no equivalent or stronger covering claim. An unindexed constrained coding formula remains a genuine risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent run-cap identity may appear in other constrained-coding, renewal, or symbolic dynamics literature that is not indexed by the completed queries.
A sufficiently explicit generic weighted automaton theorem could subsume the rational-form proof, but no located source supplies these coefficients, sharp support and CLT as a stated corollary.
Foundational 2020 source was assessed via abstract and secondary full-text statements, not direct full text.

value.rationale: Homopolymer caps define a standard, motivated constraint family. The infinite two-parameter length/index spectrum has an unexpectedly simple rational form valid at all cap values, sharp gap-free support, exactly two longest witnesses, explicit shortest counts, and Gaussian fluctuation laws interpolating from alternation toward the unrestricted source. Not a finite lookup or routine isolated coefficient.
